001package org.clafer.ig;
002
003import java.io.BufferedReader;
004import java.io.IOException;
005import java.io.PrintStream;
006import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
007import java.nio.file.Files;
008import java.nio.file.Path;
009import java.util.ArrayList;
010import java.util.Arrays;
011import java.util.List;
012import org.clafer.ig.ClaferModel.Clafer;
013
014/**
015 * The one loop of the solutions, whatever the backend: claferIG's
016 * {@code CommandLine.hs}, with clafersg's commands. A solution is an instance
017 * (Choco) or a trace (Alloy). The loop keeps the solutions shown, the most
018 * recent first, and their views: the full view or the diff view
019 * ({@code d}), the saved files ({@code e}), the Graphviz graph
020 * ({@code dot}) and the clafers found ({@code f}); the backend solves and
021 * handles its own commands.
022 */
023public final class Repl {
024
025    /**
026     * The input of the commands and the outputs: claferIG prints its
027     * solutions on the standard output and its unsat cores on the standard
028     * error.
029     */
030    public record Io(BufferedReader in, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
031    }
032
033    /**
034     * Shows a solution, which becomes the most recent one.
035     */
036    @FunctionalInterface
037    public interface Displayer {
038
039        void display(Backend.Shown shown);
040    }
041
042    /**
043     * The solutions shown so far, the most recent first: those not saved yet
044     * and those saved; the Alloy XML of the most recent; and whether they are
045     * shown as the changes from the previous snapshot.
046     */
047    public static final class Context {
048
049        final List<Solution> saved = new ArrayList<>();
050        final List<Solution> unsaved = new ArrayList<>();
051        String currentXml;
052        boolean diffView;
053        Displayer displayer;
054
055        /**
056         * Shows a solution that a backend's command found, e.g., clafersg's
057         * {@code x} and {@code z}, which becomes the most recent one.
058         */
059        public void display(Backend.Shown shown) {
060            displayer.display(shown);
061        }
062
063        /**
064         * @return how many solutions are shown and not saved
065         */
066        public int unsavedCount() {
067            return unsaved.size();
068        }
069
070        /**
071         * @return whether a solution is shown
072         */
073        public boolean hasSolution() {
074            return !unsaved.isEmpty() || !saved.isEmpty();
075        }
076
077        /**
078         * @return the Alloy XML of the most recent solution, or null
079         */
080        public String currentXml() {
081            return currentXml;
082        }
083    }
084
085    private final Backend backend;
086    private final Io io;
087    private final Context context = new Context();
088
089    /**
090     * @param diffView whether the solutions are shown as their changes
091     * ({@code --diff})
092     */
093    public Repl(Backend backend, Io io, boolean diffView) {
094        this.backend = backend;
095        this.io = io;
096        this.context.diffView = diffView;
097        this.context.displayer = this::display;
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * Runs the loop until {@code q} or the end of the input.
102     */
103    public void run() throws Exception {
104        try {
105            backend.start(io);
106            next();
107            while (true) {
108                io.out().print(backend.prompt());
109                io.out().flush();
110                String line = io.in().readLine();
111                if (line == null) {
112                    break;
113                }
114                if (!command(line)) {
115                    break;
116                }
117            }
118        } finally {
119            backend.quit();
120        }
121    }
122
123    /**
124     * @return whether the loop goes on
125     */
126    private boolean command(String input) throws Exception {
127        String trimmed = input.trim();
128        List<String> words = trimmed.isEmpty() ? List.of() : Arrays.asList(trimmed.split("\\s+"));
129        String name = words.isEmpty() ? "" : words.get(0);
130        switch (name) {
131            case "", "n", "next" -> {
132                if (words.size() > 1) {
133                    return other(input, words);
134                }
135                next();
136            }
137            case "q", "quit" -> {
138                return false;
139            }
140            case "h", "help" -> io.out().print(backend.help());
141            case "e", "save" -> save();
142            case "d", "diff" -> {
143                io.out().println(context.diffView
144                        ? "The instances and states are shown in full."
145                        : "Each next instance or state is shown as its changes from the previous one.");
146                context.diffView = !context.diffView;
147            }
148            case "dot" -> saveGraph();
149            case "f", "find" -> {
150                if (words.size() != 2) {
151                    return other(input, words);
152                }
153                find(words.get(1));
154            }
155            case "fork" -> {
156                Integer state = words.size() == 2 ? number(words.get(1)) : null;
157                if (state == null) {
158                    return other(input, words);
159                }
160                if (!backend.isDynamic()) {
161                    io.out().println("The model is static: its instances are not traces.");
162                } else {
163                    otherSolution(() -> backend.fork(io, state));
164                }
165            }
166            case "config" -> otherSolution(() -> backend.nextConfiguration(io));
167            case "check" -> {
168                Integer line = null;
169                if (words.size() == 2) {
170                    try {
171                        int n = Integer.parseInt(words.get(1));
172                        line = n > 0 ? n : null;
173                    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
174                        return other(input, words);
175                    }
176                } else if (words.size() > 2) {
177                    return other(input, words);
178                }
179                backend.check(io, line, this::display);
180            }
181            case "alloyInstance" -> io.out().println(context.currentXml == null ? "No instance" : context.currentXml);
182            default -> {
183                return other(input, words);
184            }
185        }
186        return true;
187    }
188
189    private boolean other(String input, List<String> words) throws Exception {
190        if (!backend.command(io, input, words, context)) {
191            backend.unknown(io, input);
192        }
193        return true;
194    }
195
196    private static Integer number(String s) {
197        return s.chars().allMatch(Character::isDigit) && !s.isEmpty() ? Integer.valueOf(s) : null;
198    }
199
200    private void next() throws Exception {
201        Backend.Shown shown = backend.next(io);
202        if (shown != null) {
203            display(shown);
204        }
205    }
206
207    @FunctionalInterface
208    private interface Other {
209
210        Backend.Shown get() throws Exception;
211    }
212
213    // shows a solution other than the next one: a fork, or another configuration
214    private void otherSolution(Other command) throws Exception {
215        if (!context.hasSolution()) {
216            io.out().println("No solution yet: type 'n' for the first one.");
217            return;
218        }
219        Backend.Shown shown = command.get();
220        if (shown != null) {
221            display(shown);
222        }
223    }
224
225    /**
226     * Shows a solution, which becomes the most recent one.
227     */
228    public void display(Backend.Shown shown) {
229        int n = backend.number(context);
230        Solution previous = latest();
231        io.out().print(context.diffView
232                ? SolutionView.showSolutionDiff(backend.names(), n, previous, shown.solution()) + "\n"
233                : backend.show(n, shown));
234        io.out().flush();
235        context.unsaved.add(0, shown.solution());
236        context.currentXml = shown.xml();
237    }
238
239    private Solution latest() {
240        return !context.unsaved.isEmpty() ? context.unsaved.get(0)
241                : !context.saved.isEmpty() ? context.saved.get(0) : null;
242    }
243
244    private void save() throws IOException {
245        int counter = context.saved.size();
246        for (Solution s : context.unsaved) {
247            String saveName = backend.modelFileName() + "." + counter + ".data";
248            Files.writeString(Path.of(saveName), SolutionView.solutionText(s), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
249            io.out().println("Saved to " + saveName);
250            counter++;
251        }
252        context.saved.addAll(0, context.unsaved);
253        context.unsaved.clear();
254    }
255
256    private void saveGraph() throws IOException {
257        Solution solution = latest();
258        if (solution == null) {
259            io.out().println("No solution yet: type 'n' for the first one.");
260            return;
261        }
262        int count = context.unsaved.size() + context.saved.size();
263        String saveName = backend.modelFileName() + "." + count + ".dot";
264        Files.writeString(Path.of(saveName), context.diffView
265                ? SolutionView.solutionDiffDot(backend.names(), solution)
266                : SolutionView.solutionDot(solution), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
267        io.out().println("Saved to " + saveName);
268    }
269
270    private void find(String name) {
271        Solution solution = latest();
272        if (solution == null) {
273            io.out().println("No instance");
274            return;
275        }
276        for (ClaferModel m : solution.models()) {
277            for (Clafer c : m.traverse()) {
278                if (c.name().equals(name)) {
279                    io.out().println(ClaferModel.show(c));
280                    return;
281                }
282            }
283        }
284        io.out().println("\"" + name + "\" not found in the model.");
285    }
286}
